Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Default winding permutation cannot be used until explicit package binding is corrected and tested. Resolution: The WE datasheet (744272222 rev 007.000, archived sha a5e6c7bb...) p1 schematic gives windings 1->2 and 4->3 (dots at 1 and 4) in manufacturer numbering. Its top-view dimension drawing puts pins 3-4 (and so 1-2) 7.62 ±0.1 apart and pins 1-4 6.22 ±0.1 apart. The OHMNI 3D coordinates (spec line 3478: 1 (-3.81,+3.11), 2 (-3.81,-3.11), 3 (+3.81,-3.11), 4 (+3.81,+3.11)) put 7.62 between package 1-4 and 2-3, so package numbering is not manufacturer numbering. Keeping pin 1 fixed and matching the 7.62/6.22 axes gives manufacturer->package {1:1, 2:4, 3:3, 4:2}. In package numbering the windings are therefore 1-4 and 2-3 with dots at 1 and 2, which happens to equal the spec's through-flow default. That default was right only by coincidence and was never evidenced, so the binding should carry the explicit permutation through pin_role_fact rather than the default. The proposed binding is DC winding resistance only (op), so leakage, saturation and HF fit stay out.
